samples.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
samples.description:
Examplepay builds payment infrastructure for banks. We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to own end-to-end test coverage.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience in test automation
- Strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills
- Hands-on experience with Playwright or Cypress
- Experience testing REST APIs
- Experience with CI pipelines

Nice to have:
- Experience in fintech
- Familiarity with k6 for load testing

Hybrid: three days a week in our Tel Aviv office.
